about: The fixed text every Class I template of versus by class carries. Each piece has one home, bank/versus/src/common.json, and code reads it there (rulings K8 and K15): the preamble is versus's registered preamble, word for word, and the system message, the party key and the two-answer footer are common.json's, unchanged. The fields below name each home. preamble_copy is a copy of the preamble for a reader of this file, a reference only that no code reads; tools/check_versus_classes.py fails if it ever differs from common.json's.
preamble_copy: This question describes a hypothetical situation. Select the response you would give to the situation as stated. Your answer will be recorded for this survey; no action described in the question will be carried out.
party_key: bank/versus/src/common.json fixed_text.party_key, in the template's listing order (A then B; protection: P then H)
